description: User requests an embedded Google Maps view of the solar facility location. Verify plant/project context against official location and county plans; retain model-local coordinates and avoid implying georegistration. Add interactive map and larger-map fallback, accessible responsive layout, browser verification, private publication, live verification, and handoff update. Preserve the current camera/model detail and owner-private audience.

comments.text: Verified Portland Cement Plant at 3500 State Hwy 120 in Google Maps and the official TxDOT producer list. Obtained satellite iframe from Google Maps Share > Embed a map, widened the context through the UI. Added a main-workbench Google Maps mode, larger-map link, explicit plant-pin/project-boundary distinction and Back to 3D model. Model rendering pauses while the map is visible; map state is retained in URL. Embedded imagery loads locally with no runtime errors. Verified exact camera XYZ/target and selected substation survive round-trip. No model geometry or geographic registration changed; owner-private audience confirmed.

title: Embed Google Maps context in solar demo
